text:
maria-sales: Kicking off the NovaHealth POC today at 2pm PT. Need alignment on scope/success criteria and a short integration plan. Goals: 1) embeddings + semantic search over clinical notes, 2) concise alert summaries for clinicians (real-time), 3) 2-week evaluation window. Can @ben-ps, @sam-ml, @elaine-eng, @priya-security weigh in on SDK/auth, quotas, streaming, retries, and security blockers?

ben-ps: Quick q — do we expect streaming summaries (partial tokens) or batch generation? That changes how we suggest the SDK paths. Also what throughput should we size the POC for (rps / concurrent users)?

maria-sales: Primary flow is near-real-time: summary as notes are ingested (sub-2s visible to clinician ideally). For load, target 10 concurrent clinicians, approx 1 request every 10s each => ~1 req/s sustained, but spikes possible. Streaming preferred if it helps perceived latency.

sam-ml: For success criteria I'd propose: embedding retrieval recall@10 >= 0.88 on their labeled set; summary ROUGE-L >= 0.35 or manual clinician accept >= 80%; p50 latency < 400ms, p95 < 1.5s for single-turn summary (with streaming). Eval set: 200 clinical notes + 50 edge-case prompts. Also need to confirm model family (open Llama family vs tuned instruction model) — affects cost/latency.

elaine-eng: For the POC we can do API-key auth for speed; recommend creating a scoped key with limited lifetime and a token policy (read-only embeddings + generate). For production we suggest SSO + ephemeral tokens + KMS for key material. Default quotas for POC env: 100 req/s, 200k tokens/min soft limit (we can reduce on request). Retries: client should implement idempotency-key for generate calls, exponential backoff (base 200ms, max 5s, 4 retries).

ben-ps: SDK snippet for streaming (Node) — use this in the quickstart:

```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const stream = await client.generate.stream({ model: 'redwood-stream-1', prompt: 'Summarize notes...', max_tokens: 256 });
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
}
```

Notes: if they want websockets, we can provide a ws endpoint; otherwise SSE works fine.

priya-security: From security side — NovaHealth is asking about SOC2, encryption, and data residency. We are SOC2 Type II. Data in hosted mode is encrypted at rest and in transit; customer can request VPC/private deployment for strict isolation. For POC we can set short retention (7 days) and opt-out of logging. We'll provide a filled security questionnaire (will send PDF by EOD). Also confirm no PHI is persisted in logs unless they opt in — we can set logging to redact.

maria-sales: Great. On pricing: they asked about estimated cost for 2-week POC at expected volume. Ben, can you provide a ballpark (embeddings + generations)? They want a committed number to show finance.

ben-ps: Ballpark: assuming 200 notes/day * embedding unit cost + 1000 short summaries total over two weeks. Rough estimate ~ $600–900 for hosted usage depending on model choice and token counts. If they pick a quantized dedicated model price comes down significantly. I’ll make a short calc and drop it in the ticket.

sam-ml: Integration notes: use prefix/KV caching for repeated contexts (alerts often reuse templates). Recommend batching embedding calls (up to 16) to reduce unit cost. Also hold a small evaluation harness (pytest-like) with 50 prompts to run nightly to detect quality regressions.

elaine-eng: Operationally, set up a demo POC environment: created env redwood-poc-novahealth (infra-bot will post link). I'll spin up rate-limit rules to 20 req/s and a scoped API key expiring in 14 days. Endpoint: https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate (will share key via 1:1).

infra-bot: Created POC environment redwood-poc-novahealth · env-id: poc-nova-002 · config: rate_limit=20rps, retention=7d · link: https://internal.redwood/envs/poc-nova-002

priya-security: Also flag: they require a signed DPA before we send any sample logs — legal to handle. I'll loop legal.

maria-sales: Next steps: Ben to post detailed cost calc, Elaine to share API key + endpoint, Priya to send security questionnaire and DPA note, Sam to prepare eval prompt set (I'll give them sample notes). Target: POC go-live tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup:

ben-ps: Will post numbers in 30m.

elaine-eng: API key shared via 1:1 secure channel.

sam-ml: Started draft eval set, will push to repo and tag you, @maria-sales.

priya-security: Security questionnaire sent (check email).

maria-sales: Thanks everyone — I'll update the customer after the call.
